title: Invertibility of the two fixed affine pullback model comparisons
statement: Let $R,B$ be commutative rings, $g:\operatorname{Spec}(B)\to\operatorname{Spec}(R)$, and $M$ a K-flat unbounded cochain complex of $R$-modules [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Assume additive associated-sheaf and tensor-pullback functors [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction, lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Put $K=\widetilde M$ and $PK=g^*K$. The fixed left-derived counit of [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], transported along the canonical $Q/Q_h$ isomorphisms, gives $d:Lg^*(QK)\to Q(PK)$. The canonical sections map $c:Q(\Gamma_B(PK))\to R\Gamma_B(Q(PK))$ uses the right-derived unit and exact scalar restriction of [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map]. Both $d$ and $c$ are isomorphisms, for the exact definitions affineModelPullbackComparison and affineModelSectionsComparison in lean.file.

proof.text: Translate generic module K-flatness to the acyclic tensor criterion on the homotopy quotient; apply isKFlat_tilde. The K-flat counit of exists_derivedPullback is invertible. Uniqueness of left-derived functors transfers invertibility to the fixed counit used in exists_derivedPullbackComposition, and the Q/Qh transports preserve it.

Full faithfulness of Spec writes g as Spec.map of its ring map. Transport the natural tensor-pullback/tilde isomorphism to complexes and homotopy objects. Naturality of the right-derived sections unit transfers its invertibility from the scalar-extended tilde complex; affineTildeDerivedSectionsUnit_isIso applies without boundedness. Compose with the invertible Q/Qh transports and affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso.

lean.statement:
theorem affinePullbackModelComparisons_isIso
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R)
    [hT : (tilde.functor R).Additive] [hP : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M) :
    let K := (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (tilde.functor R) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M
    IsIso (affineModelPullbackComparison g K) ∧
      IsIso (affineModelSectionsComparison B
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K))
